items.title: Edward "Eddie" Richardson Interview, 1960-10-29
items.q: The name 'Molly' appears only in the interviewer's question: '[Marjorie Zander] Do you have any questions, Molly?' The interviewee responds to the interviewer, not Molly, and no prior interaction or relationship with Molly is described in the transcript.

ctx.x: Well I prefer dances. I prefer playing in where people are dancing. Those parades are all right but sometimes you get a job and it looks like they walk all over the city. In Carnival Day you've got to be in condition. You've got to be in condition to walk for Carnival Day. Who did you play for on Carnival Day, what clubs? I think it was the Garden District. I remember the Corner Club used to have some bands too. They'd have those rehearsals first. I used to go up there to the channel and hear those people. Yeah…
Do you have any questions, Molly?

Not that I can think of right now. Yeah, I thought maybe you had something special on funeral bands or something like that. What are some of the hymns that you all play with the Gibson band? That's one thing I'd like to know. Well the Gibson, they play all those hymns. They play by and by when the morning comes, walk through the streets of the city, over in the glory land, saints. That's about all I can remember. And then they play, they have a march they play. What's the name of that march? We just call the name…
